CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.izytel_current_manager_zone_ids()
 RETURNS text[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(array_agg(z.id order by z.id),'{}'::text[])
  from public.territory_zones z
  where z.is_active=true
    and z.manager_id=(select auth.jwt()->>'sub')
    and private.izytel_current_staff_role() in ('manager','supervisor');
$function$

functions.name: izytel_notification_zone_recipients
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.izytel_notification_zone_recipients(p_zone text)
 RETURNS SETOF text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with managers as (
    select s.firebase_uid from public.territory_zones z
    join public.izytel_staff_access s on s.firebase_uid=z.manager_id
    where z.id=p_zone and z.is_active and s.is_active and s.role in ('manager','supervisor')
  )
  select firebase_uid from managers
  union all
  select firebase_uid from public.izytel_staff_access
  where is_active and role='admin' and not exists(select 1 from managers);
$function$

functions.name: izytel_partner_success_post_settlement
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.izytel_partner_success_post_settlement()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_plan_id uuid;
  v_settlement jsonb;
begin
  select p.id into v_plan_id
  from public.compensation_plans p
  where p.actor_type='cabiniste'
    and p.plan_scope='standard'
    and p.status='active'
    and (p.effective_from is null or p.effective_from<=new.financial_applied_at)
    and (p.effective_to is null or p.effective_to>new.financial_applied_at)
  order by p.version desc
  limit 1;

  if v_plan_id is null then
    raise exception 'ACTIVE_CABINISTE_PLAN_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;

  v_settlement := private.izytel_post_cabiniste_settlement(
    new.order_id,
    new.order_reference,
    new.partner_id,
    new.partner_name,
    new.cabiniste_settlement_amount,
    v_plan_id,
    new.telecom_margin_amount,
    new.cabiniste_margin_amount,
    new.izytel_gross_gain,
    new.financial_applied_at
  );

  new.compensation_entry_id :=
    nullif(v_settlement->>'entryId','')::uuid;

  update public.order_economics
  set economic_status='validated',
      updated_at=now()
  where order_id=new.order_id
    and executor_type='cabiniste'
    and executor_id=new.partner_id::text
    and economic_status='pending';

  return new;
end;
$function$

functions.name: izytel_post_cabiniste_settlement
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.izytel_post_cabiniste_settlement(p_order_id text, p_order_reference text, p_partner_id uuid, p_partner_name text, p_amount bigint, p_plan_id uuid, p_telecom_margin_amount bigint, p_cabiniste_margin_amount bigint, p_izytel_gross_gain bigint, p_occurred_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_key text := 'cabiniste_settlement:order:' || btrim(coalesce(p_order_id,''));
  v_period_key text;
  v_period_start date;
  v_period_end date;
  v_entry_id uuid;
  v_period_id uuid;
  v_existing boolean := false;
begin
  if p_partner_id is null then
    raise exception 'PARTNER_REQUIRED';
  end if;

  if btrim(coalesce(p_order_id,''))='' then
    raise exception 'ORDER_ID_REQUIRED';
  end if;

  if coalesce(p_amount,0)<=0 then
    raise exception 'INVALID_SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT';
  end if;

  if p_plan_id is null then
    raise exception 'COMPENSATION_PLAN_REQUIRED';
  end if;

  v_period_key := to_char(
    coalesce(p_occurred_at,now()) at time zone 'UTC',
    'YYYY-MM'
  );
  v_period_start := date_trunc(
    'month',
    coalesce(p_occurred_at,now()) at time zone 'UTC'
  )::date;
  v_period_end := (
    date_trunc(
      'month',
      coalesce(p_occurred_at,now()) at time zone 'UTC'
    ) + interval '1 month - 1 day'
  )::date;

  select id into v_entry_id
  from public.compensation_entries
  where idempotency_key=v_key;

  if found then
    v_existing := true;
  else
    insert into public.compensation_entries(
      actor_type,
      actor_id,
      entry_type,
      amount,
      currency,
      order_id,
      order_reference,
      period_key,
      plan_id,
      idempotency_key,
      metadata,
      occurred_at
    ) values(
      'cabiniste',
      p_partner_id::text,
      'cabiniste_settlement',
      p_amount,
      'XOF',
      btrim(p_order_id),
      btrim(coalesce(p_order_reference,'')),
      v_period_key,
      p_plan_id,
      v_key,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'partnerName',btrim(coalesce(p_partner_name,'')),
        'telecomMarginAmount',coalesce(p_telecom_margin_amount,0),
        'cabinisteMarginAmount',coalesce(p_cabiniste_margin_amount,0),
        'izytelGrossGain',coalesce(p_izytel_gross_gain,0),
        'settlementAmount',p_amount,
        'economicRule','80_20_plus_10'
      ),
      coalesce(p_occurred_at,now())
    )
    returning id into v_entry_id;

    insert into public.compensation_accounts(
      actor_type,
      actor_id,
      actor_display_name,
      currency,
      earned_total,
      paid_total,
      earned_transactions,
      last_entry_id
    ) values(
      'cabiniste',
      p_partner_id::text,
      btrim(coalesce(p_partner_name,'')),
      'XOF',
      p_amount,
      0,
      1,
      v_entry_id
    )
    on conflict(actor_type,actor_id) do update
    set actor_display_name=excluded.actor_display_name,
        earned_total=public.compensation_accounts.earned_total+p_amount,
        earned_transactions=
          public.compensation_accounts.earned_transactions+1,
        last_entry_id=v_entry_id,
        updated_at=now();

    insert into public.compensation_periods(
      actor_type,
      actor_id,
      period_key,
      period_start,
      period_end,
      status,
      base_amount,
      variable_amount,
      adjustment_amount,
      total_amount
    ) values(
      'cabiniste',
      p_partner_id::text,
      v_period_key,
      v_period_start,
      v_period_end,
      'open',
      0,
      p_amount,
      0,
      p_amount
    )
    on conflict(actor_type,actor_id,period_key) do update
    set variable_amount=
          public.compensation_periods.variable_amount+p_amount,
        total_amount=
          public.compensation_periods.total_amount+p_amount,
        updated_at=now()
    where public.compensation_periods.status='open'
    returning id into v_period_id;

    if v_period_id is null then
      raise exception 'COMPENSATION_PERIOD_NOT_OPEN';
    end if;
  end if;

  if v_period_id is null then
    select id into v_period_id
    from public.compensation_periods
    where actor_type='cabiniste'
      and actor_id=p_partner_id::text
      and period_key=v_period_key;
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'entryId',v_entry_id,
    'periodId',v_period_id,
    'periodKey',v_period_key,
    'amount',p_amount,
    'idempotent',v_existing
  );
end;
$function$
